audience: Sales operations teams that run quotes, DealRooms and CRM opportunities in DealHub

useCases.title: Find quotes for a CRM opportunity
useCases.text: List quotes, optionally only those linked to one CRM opportunity. Open one quote with the detail sections you choose.

useCases.title: Check who signed a DealRoom contract
useCases.text: Read the DealRoom state and the buyer and seller signers for a CRM opportunity, with their signature dates.

useCases.title: Review versions
useCases.text: List the versions by status, or open one version by id. The active version is the one that quotes use.

useCases.title: Look up users
useCases.text: List users, or open one user by login or by id. Passwords and tokens are never returned.

useCases.title: Create an opportunity for a renewal
useCases.text: Create a DealHub opportunity from a CRM opportunity, with its owner, currency and customer. The record is written in DealHub.
